reader.requirement: In format 1 a qualifier must be a file-name/cd-name (level indicator), a group to which the item is subordinate, or a condition-name's conditional variable (and its groups), written innermost first; any other qualifier or order identifies nothing.
reader.edition-search: grep for DialectLevel, Edition.Year, EditionContext, CobolVersion, Permissive and ConstructRegistry in NameResolution.cs, SymbolTable.DataNameCandidates.cs, SymbolTable.IndexNames.cs, SymbolTable.Procedures.cs, SymbolTable.ConditionNames.cs, QualifiedNameClasses.cs, OccursKeyResolvePass.cs, OdoResolvePass.cs, StatementValidation.cs, DataBinder.cs#UniqueOrReportAmbiguous; the grammar rules qualification, dataReference, procedureName and reportGroupReference carry no version predicate
reader.witnesses-cover: part: condition-name and data-name chains and a report group; wrong order, sibling qualifiers, a wrong file and cd-name qualifiers are not exercised

probes.printed: exit 0: AAAA BBBB / CCCC DDDD / OK-R1-A OK-R1-B OK-R2-C OK-R2-D / 78 / 123 / CCCC / UNIQ / ZZZZZ / FFF12GGG34
probes.expected: every reference made unique by its qualifiers resolves to its own item: full and gapped chains, IN and OF mixed, record-name as data-name-1 and as qualifier, file-name qualifier, condition-names qualified by their conditional variable and its groups, subscripted qualified items, an unqualified unique name

probes.printed: exit 65, ten COBOL1639: X (2 match), X OF G (2 match), X OF R1 OF G (order), X OF T OF R1 (sibling not superordinate), UNIQ OF UNIQ, OK OF N OF R1 (not its conditional variable), OK (2 level-88s), FX OF GREC OF F1 (wrong file), FX (2), X OF R3 (no such qualifier)
probes.expected: each nonunique or misqualified reference refused (1985 IV.4.3.8.1 SRL2.1, SRL2.4)

probes.printed: exit 65: COBOL2776 'OF T' follows a subscript ... write the qualifiers first (line 40); line 41 E OF T OF R1 (1) accepted

probes.expected: DEST-COUNT OF CDA and DEST-COUNT IN OREC2 IN CDB resolve through format 1's cd-name qualifier

probes.printed: exit 65: COBOL2353 'K OF R1 OF T' ... no data item so named under the written qualifiers
probes.expected: a key with qualifiers out of hierarchy order names nothing

citations.check: OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SRL2.4  the text is in SRL2.4 (quoted: Qualifiers are specified in the order of successively more inclusive levels)

reader.notes: The walk starts at the item's parent (AT the conditional variable for a level-88) and lets only the outermost qualifier be the owning file or cd-name; probes refuse wrong order, a sibling group, the item itself, a non-associated variable and another file's record, and COBOL2776 refuses a qualifier written after a subscript.
